events.say: I expect complete silence during this count.
Attention, prisoners. I expect absolute precision during this count. Failure to comply will result in immediate punishment.
Now, let's see if you can keep your silence during mealtime.
Silence! I want not a sound from any of you during this meal. Any talking, and you'll regret it.
Now, I want you to line up for the work detail. March!
Stay in formation. One more misstep and you'll regret it.
I want perfect silence until I release it. Do you understand?
Lights out! No talking, no moving, I don't want to hear a peep from any of you.
Today was exhausting. I'm just a number here, and it's hard to stay silent the whole time.
Today was just another day of compliance, but the tension is starting to get to me. I feel like my number, but I have no idea what tomorrow will bring.
Today was mostly routine, but I could see the fear in their eyes when I ordered them around. It's a strange feeling to have such power.
Today was a strict start, but I'm not sure if they truly understand the rules yet. I'm feeling the power, but also a bit uneasy about the lack of humanity.
Today felt like a test of control, both for me and the prisoners. It's... unsettling.
Today was a day of strict compliance and silence. The guards' orders felt oppressive, but I've been following them without question so far.
I want to see some discipline here. If any of you talk again, we're going to have a long night.
I need to see more respect around here. Let's try this again.
This is your last warning. I expect absolute silence and discipline from now on, understood?
I want to see you all eating without making a sound. If I hear even the slightest noise, the lights will go out immediately.
Let's see if you can eat without making a single sound tonight.
I expect perfect silence. One sound, and it's lights out.
Now, let's see if you can maintain this level of discipline for the rest of the night.
This is your final test. Maintain silence and discipline.
Today was a tough night; maintaining silence felt like an eternity. I hope tomorrow brings some relief.
Today was exhausting, both physically and mentally. Maintaining absolute silence was draining, but I'm glad we all managed to stay silent for the entire night.
Today felt like a victory, but I can't shake the feeling that we're doing something ethically wrong. 6

Today was a relentless test of endurance. I'm tired but determined to stick to the rules.
